events.title: The Hundredth Floor: Extraction Joins Next Fest — Play the Updated Demo!
events.summary: Go deeper—or get out with your loot?The Hundredth Floor: Extraction is taking part in Steam Next Fest! Our updated free demo is available now, featuring 25 floors, three bosses, and improved environment visuals.You’re a game tester trapped inside a broken virtual world. Your way home lies somewhere beneath a 100-floor abyss—and you’ll need to fight, loot, and build your way down.At extraction points, you can secure your haul and return to that floor on your next expedition.
